sources.name: Gujarat TPVD — Surat final town-planning plots
sources.scope: Final Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) town-planning plot boundaries from Gujarat TPVD. Partial planning-scheme coverage; not a current title/ownership registry or citywide completeness claim. Native search reference combines village, scheme and final-plot labels. Single counted responses up to 1,000 records; larger scopes reject because this provider misreports terminal offset-page counts.
sources.attribution: Government of Gujarat, Town Planning and Valuation Department (TPVD) — final SMC planning plots. Partial coverage; registration and currentness unverified. Adapted to WGS84.
sources.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational. No named reuse licence was identified on the inspected public map.
caveats: The official TPVD website links to the public TPWebGIS host; no account is used.
Final planning plots are not proof of current land title or ownership. Draft, preliminary and non-SMC schemes are excluded by fixed upstream and response-validated filters.
The server omits its certificate intermediate. A source-scoped published Sectigo intermediate completes the trusted chain; hostname and certificate validation remain enabled.
WFS FIDs and gid are transport data, not parcel identities.
The legacy WFS misreports the total on a final partial offset page. Queries request up to 1000 records and reject match counts above 1000; no offset-counter relaxation is applied.
Sampled adjacent Piplod 6 92 and Umra_North 5 177 boundaries have a 0.239 m² overlap with about 9 mm minimum oriented width. Source geometry is retained unchanged.
